about: Audio production plan for the V5 script on the locked V4 timings. One entry per voice line V01–V26: exact text, locked timing, pace, delivery, sync points (= caption beats) and ElevenLabs settings. Generated by scripts/build-audio-production.py from navislabs_v5_voiceover_screen_map.json and the resolved beats.

voice.who: Abhishek Meena — his own voice, or an ElevenLabs Professional Voice Clone of it made with his explicit permission. No other voice.
voice.character: Abhishek Meena's own voice (or an ElevenLabs clone of it made with his permission). Calm, deep, precise, technical, confident, understated, founder-led — natural to Abhishek's own accent. Not a commercial announcer, trailer voice, AI voice, overly American, overly dramatic, or fast social-media narration.
voice.pace_reference: calm founder narration ≈ 3.5–4.5 syllables/s; 'tight' means the hard end forces more than 4.8 syllables/s

elevenlabs_defaults.model: eleven_v4 with Abhishek Meena's cloned voice (Professional Voice Clones are fully supported in eleven_v4).
elevenlabs_defaults.not_available_in_v4: Style and Speed sliders are not available in eleven_v4; speaker boost is not listed as a v4 setting. Do not look for them — pace and emphasis come from the text, punctuation and retakes.
elevenlabs_defaults.if_another_model_is_used: Only if v4 is unusable for a line: eleven_multilingual_v2 exposes Style (start 0), Speaker boost (on) and Speed (1.0). The plan does not depend on them.
elevenlabs_defaults.post: The final audio may be trimmed and aligned in post (heads, tails, the pause at a dash or full stop) without changing the narration. Never time-stretch.
elevenlabs_defaults.pauses: eleven_v4 does not support SSML: use punctuation (commas, full stops, dashes, ellipses) and line structure
elevenlabs_defaults.pronunciation: eleven_v4: IPA between slashes inline, e.g. /ˈnævɪs/, only if the clone mispronounces 'Navis' (results can vary — audition)
elevenlabs_defaults.audio_tags: sparingly: 8 of 26 lines carry an optional tag; drop any tag that makes the read sound acted
elevenlabs_defaults.output: request 48 kHz PCM / WAV (or the highest-quality MP3 if PCM is unavailable); Claude converts to 48 kHz, 24-bit, mono WAV
elevenlabs_defaults.generation: generate one passage at a time (P1–P6) for a consistent tone; Claude splits each passage take at its pauses into V01–V26. Per-line generation also works.

passages.text_v4:
[calm] Your people and agents see different truths.

The truth is scattered across the systems where work happens.

People rebuild it by hand. Agents start without it.

[confident] Navis turns those signals into one shared understanding.

Every email, meeting, document and message becomes a signal —

remembered, connected, and turned into what should happen next.

[warm] Inside a company, the Navis App is for people.

It shows what changed — Acme's renewal moved.

And why: every fact with its source, its time, and how fresh it is.

It's waiting on you, so Navis drafts the reply.

[firm] A person decides.

Then the company acts.

The same company's agents use Navis Developer.

Invite the team. Connect once — MCP, API, SDK or CLI.

The agent asks — and gets cited facts, with their freshness.

Navis isn't the model. It supplies the company's truth.

[quietly] Every request is checked against its permissions.

The agent does the work, and the run is on record.

[warm] A solo builder gets a private workspace — and the work state carries into the next session.

One company. The person and the agent acted on the same event.

Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.

One understanding. Two ways in.

[thoughtful] Models change. Agents change. Tools change.

What it knows stays yours.

Company-owned. Model-neutral. Shared by people and agents.

[softly] NavisLabs. The shared understanding for your organization.
